g.text: Transmitted frame, receiver PAC grid, and calculated timing

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Liberation Serif'; text-anchor: end

g.text: Each condition has three aligned bars: on-air TX, receiver PAC grid, and receiver frame budget. t = 0 marks the first transmitted preamble symbol.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Serif'; text-anchor: start

g.text: HOW TO READ THE THREE BARS
TX is fixed at t=0; PAC and RX shift with lead.
Gray denotes missed preamble or a discarded PAC.
Dashed line: calculated TX preamble end.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Serif'; text-anchor: start

g.text: PAC8 L6 and PAC4 L2: first full RX, 2,000/2,000.
L14 ACCUM 16×1,957 and 8×43 in one run.
One run/lead; M64 L0 was not tested in CH5.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Serif'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Only RX counts and ACCUM are observations.
L0 shortfall assumes its first PAC is discarded.
Startup ~11.3 µs and PAC phase are modeled.
CALCULATED: TX preamble/SFD durations from PHY symbols; M32 RX command = −(lead + 1.2948) µs from the executed code. Purple ▼ = modeled RX-ready.
OBSERVED: CH5 Stage0 RX counts and ACCUM only. *≈11.3 µs startup, detection widths, PAC grid, and L0 PAC discard are conditional, not chip timestamps; M64 L0 unmeasured.
